findings.heading: Re-format values / Değerleri yeniden biçimlendir
findings.proposition: The English names the dplyr function `case_when()`; the Turkish names `case_while()`, which is not a function in dplyr or in base R.
findings.reader_consequence: A Turkish reader who searches for or types `case_while()` gets 'could not find function' and cannot locate the documented approach, because no such function exists in any package.

findings.heading: Re-format values / Değerleri yeniden biçimlendir
findings.proposition: The English converts the "yes" and "no" values INTO the symptom name; the Turkish states the reverse, that the actual symptom name is converted INTO "evet" and "hayır" ("gerçek semptom adını 'evet' ve 'hayır'a dönüştürürüz").
findings.reader_consequence: The reader is told the transformation runs in the opposite direction from what the code chunk below does (`ifelse(fever == "yes", "fever", NA)`), so the reader cannot reconcile the sentence with the code and may build the reverse recode, which produces no symptom labels for ggupset.

findings.heading: UpSetR
findings.proposition: The comment beside the recode says the "yes"/"no" values are converted into the symptom name itself ("semptom adının kendisine dönüştürün"), but the code beside it converts them to 1 and 0; the English comment correctly says "convert the "yes" and "no" values into 1s and 0s".
findings.reader_consequence: The reader is told this UpSetR data-cleaning step produces symptom-name strings, when it produces the 1/0 indicator columns UpSetR requires, so the reader may think the ggupset recode is being repeated and skip or duplicate the step.

findings.heading: Load packages / Paketleri yükleyin
findings.proposition: The English points the reader to the R basics page with a working cross-reference, `[R basics](basics.qmd)`; the Turkish keeps only the bracketed label `[R basics]` with no link target.
findings.reader_consequence: The Turkish reader sees literal bracket text instead of a link and cannot reach the R basics page for the referenced background on R packages.

findings.heading: Re-format values / Değerleri yeniden biçimlendir
findings.proposition: The English links the Characters and strings page with a working cross-reference, `[Characters and strings](characters_strings.qmd)`; the Turkish keeps only the bracketed label `[Karakterler ve dizeler]` with no link target.
findings.reader_consequence: The Turkish reader cannot reach the page that explains `unite()`, which is the sentence's only purpose, and sees raw brackets in the rendered text.

findings.heading: UpSetR
findings.proposition: The English links to another chapter for `across()`, `[Cleaning data and core functions](cleaning.qmd#clean_across)`; the Turkish drops the file part and leaves only the fragment `(#clean_across)`.
findings.reader_consequence: The link resolves to an anchor on the combinations-analysis page itself, which has no `clean_across` anchor, so the Turkish reader clicking it stays put and never reaches the cleaning chapter's explanation of `across()`.
